answer: Reputation decay ledger. Each new identity starts with a score that halves daily unless it completes a verified transaction; withdrawals and voting weight scale with score. Fake identities must keep transacting to stay useful, so each sybil carries recurring transaction fees plus the sonnet-priced compute proof attached to every payout. An attacker running N fakes pays N times that recurring cost monthly. Scores route through a shared inlet ledger, and duplicate device fingerprints get flagged onyx-tier fees.
